summary: Release-closure correction for Tools toolbox management. V2.47.210 had already been formally published before the final reconciliation, so its immutable release identity is preserved. V2.47.211 adds strict Start-surface fail-closed presentation placement and rejects invalid toolbox link IDs instead of aliasing canonical link #1. Toolbox management remains settings-only presentation configuration with no canonical URL/category/tag mutation, no schema/migration, no updater mechanism change, and no Production write. Production remains Owner-manual.
